cellar.title: Wine & bermet
cellar.intro: Karlovci is wine country on the slopes of Fruška Gora. We pour local wines and bermet, the Karlovci speciality.
cellar.bermetText: Bermet is an aromatic wine flavoured with herbs and spices that Sremski Karlovci is known for. Sip it slowly — as an aperitif or with dessert.

story.title: The house across from the fountain
story.lead: A small 18th-century house on the main square, with an entrance that is easy to miss — and a terrace right across from the Four Lions Fountain.
story.fountainText: Built in 1799 as the crown of the town’s first waterworks, designed by the Italian architect Giuseppe Aprili. Baroque, red marble — the symbol of Karlovci. Fully restored in 2007.
story.legend: “Whoever drinks from the fountain will return to Karlovci.”
story.borderTitle: On the border of two worlds
story.borderText: The Treaty of Karlowitz between the Habsburg and Ottoman empires was signed here in 1699. Our menu still lives on that border — between Vienna and Istanbul.
